title: Marble
description: This week's records dropped on water like Turkish marbling ink, over a ground of stones cut from each cover's own colour, and the first thing you see is a comb pulled straight through a whole album into a razor-sharp feather. Drag back the other way and the feather un-pulls exactly, because every pixel is solved backwards through every drop and pull.
intent: One exact marbling mechanic, finished to the edge: real album covers as inks, area-preserving drops, and analytic tines you can pull and un-pull without the image ever going soft.
